title: WaterColor "Happy Place Beach House" 81 Western Lake Drive
h1: WaterColor "Happy Place Beach House" 81 Western Lake Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor Community guidelines the maximum number of wristbands this home is allotted is 14 bands to access WaterColor amenities and community pools- Located in the beautiful Beach community of WaterColor- 7 adult bikes - Private pool **Pool heating is available for this property from October 1st through May 1st for $40 per day**- Carriage house- SONOS sound system- Parking for 2 vehicles- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and a third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Happy Place Beach House—the promise is in the name! Collectively featuring 7 bedrooms and 6.5 bathrooms between the Main House and Carriage House, this WaterColor property is the ultimate Emerald Coast retreat with a private pool, multiple outdoor spaces, and beautiful accommodations for 14 guests. WaterColor’s famous Beach Club is only a short walk, and guests have access to all community amenities, including pickleball courts, footpaths, pools, and sugar-sand beaches.The Main House’s first floor features a spacious mudroom with 2 washers and 2 dryers, as well as 2 guest bedrooms—2 twin beds are in the first, and 1 king bed is in the second. In the courtyard, a shimmering private pool, lounge chairs, porch swing, and Sonos sound system create an idyllic hideaway.Natural light fills the main-level great room, adorned with wicker accents, glittering chandeliers, and floor-to-ceiling French doors. There’s room to gather with a sofa and 2 armchairs around the Smart TV, plus 2 additional armchairs beside the 10-person dining table. The gourmet kitchen is a chef’s dream, boasting high-end appliances, ample counter space, and a 5-stool breakfast bar. Enjoy a refreshing drink on the covered balcony’s cushioned furniture or at the 8-seat alfresco table. Off the dining area is a second outdoor space with a 2-person bistro set, daybed, and outdoor kitchen. Retire for the night in the luxe primary bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom.Take the stairs to the lookout tower for amazing ocean views and sunsets.For privacy, retreat to the charming Carriage House featuring a living space, kitchen, 2-seat table, and guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom.Discover space, convenience, and luxury at WaterColor’s Happy Place Beach House. Parking for 2 vehicles and 7 complimentary adult bikes makes exploring easy. Both private beach accesses are less than a 5-minute walk. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 14):FIRST FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub combo-Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate THIRD FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only -Bunk Room: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only-Loft Bedroom: 2 Twin Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only-Additional Sleeping Area: Sunroom with 2 Twin BedsCARRIAGE HOUSE:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*Weddings are not allowed at this home. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico. DETAILS: Happy Place Beach House—the promise is in the name! Collectively featuring 7 bedrooms and 6.5 bathrooms between the Main House and Carriage House, this WaterColor property is the ultimate Emerald Coast retreat with a private pool, multiple outdoor spaces, and beautiful accommodations for 14 guests. WaterColor’s famous Beach Club is only a short walk, and guests have access to all community amenities, including pickleball courts, footpaths, pools, and sugar-sand beaches. The Main House’s first floor features a spacious mudroom with 2 washers and 2 dryers, as well as 2 guest bedrooms—2 twin beds are in the first, and 1 king bed is in the second. In the courtyard, a shimmering private pool, lounge chairs, porch swing, and Sonos sound system create an idyllic hideaway. Natural light fills the main-level great room, adorned with wicker accents, glittering chandeliers, and floor-to-ceiling French doors. There’s room to gather with a sofa and 2 armchairs around the Smart TV, plus 2 additional armchairs beside the 10-person dining table. The gourmet kitchen is a chef’s dream, boasting high-end appliances, ample counter space, and a 5-stool breakfast bar. Enjoy a refreshing drink on the covered balcony’s cushioned furniture or at the 8-seat alfresco table. Off the dining area is a second outdoor space with a 2-person bistro set, daybed, and outdoor kitchen. Retire for the night in the luxe primary bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom. Take the stairs to the lookout tower for amazing ocean views and sunsets. For privacy, retreat to the charming Carriage House featuring a living space, kitchen, 2-seat table, and guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom. Discover space, convenience, and luxury at WaterColor’s Happy Place Beach House. Parking for 2 vehicles and 7 complimentary adult bikes makes exploring easy. Both private beach accesses are less than a 5-minute walk. Book today!
